{
  "observation": "The robot moved the rust mat onto the raised shelf. The person then pointed at the mat and toward the tabletop. The teal mat stayed in place.",
  "interpretation": "The gesture may have been a request to put the rust mat back. It did not clearly identify the teal mat as the one to shelve.",
  "title": "Check which mat should stay",
  "note": "For this workbench, the number of parts on a mat may be a poor guide to which mat the person wants within reach.",
  "question": "Should I put the rust mat back and shelve the teal one instead?"
}
